view.doc: a roll-top bread box opens at the front

cookware.doc: Pots and pans: conduct heat to their contents.

food_container.doc: Lidded food storage container (closing the lid = covered/airtight).

view.doc: a handwritten marker label on a storage container: capitals about 8 mm

food_item.doc: Any piece or portion of food. food.* holds kind/cat/phase/qty_g/cut/parts/composition; hidden truth in _ keys.

food_outer_packaging.doc: A sleeve/box/shrink-wrap removed from a grocery item; recycle cardboard/PET, trash film.

kitchen_scale.doc: Digital scale: 5 kg x 1 g. Display = (load - tare) in the unit setting; O-Ld when overloaded.

packaged_food.doc: A sealed retail package (carton, bag, box, can, jar, bottle, tray). The package is the food entity; portions taken out become new items.

view.doc: printed best-by / use-by codes on retail packs are inkjet characters about 2-3 mm tall

prep_scraps.doc: Peels, trimmings, pits, bones; waste_stream says where they may go.

recipe_card.doc: A printed or handwritten recipe: text is readable; _recipe holds the structured truth for grading reports.
